differences.detail: The reference ships an owner-name literal (a sibling-project name listed in release-identity.env's PAPERCUSP_RELEASE_OWNER_NAME) unscrubbed in these 6 files. The reproduction, with the env sourced, rewrote it to 'owner-…'. The reference mdx blob equals git at 29bf7350, i.e. it was never scrubbed. The cut log shows 'owner-name preflight: 1 explicit owner-name literal(s) resolved' (the env file holds more than one) and 'PARTIAL COVERAGE: EMAIL not covered', and the audit still printed CLEAN. The desktop cut path does not load owner-identity-env.ts. The 0.0.25 cut sidecar (relcut-0025) carries the same 6 files

verdict.summary: The operator payload reproduces from the pinned source in a separate checkout on a different path and filesystem. mcp-proxy.mjs is byte-identical. serve.mjs differs only in the 2 bytes of the baked version input the reproduction did not supply. 14089 of the 14127 files present in both trees are identical. Of the 38 that differ: 25 are an unlocked nested pg dependency tree (WI-10004350, a defect in both builds); 6 are docs where the reference cut failed to scrub an owner-name literal (WI-10004349, a release-privacy defect that also affects the 0.0.25 cut); 3 are Rust build-path binaries; 2 are timestamps and provenance inputs; 1 is the version input; 1 is a time-derived seed value. The reference-only files come from later cut steps. Because of WI-10004349 the signed 0.0.26 should not be published; a re-cut with the owner identity env loaded is required.
